_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Destructive Physical Analysis Plan
summary: The Destructive Physical Analysis Plan describes how a contractor will establish sampling, acceptance, and rejection criteria for destructive physical analysis of parts used in high reliability spacecraft equipment.
use_relationship:
The Destructive Physical Analysis plan identifies in detail how the contractor will establish sampling, acceptance, and rejection criteria for DPA of parts for use in high reliability spacecraft equipment.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract. Refer to MIL-STD-1580(B)1, "Destructive Physical Analysis (DPA) for Electronic, Electromagnetic, and Electromechanical Parts," (entire document) for further guidance on the part types subject to DPA.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Destructive Physical Analysis plan shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Destructive Physical Analysis (DPA) plan shall contain the following:

children.title: Lot sampling technique.
children.content: Describes the method of conducting the lot sampling for each device type.

children.title: Lot acceptance criteria.
children.content: Describes the acceptance criteria that will be applied against each device type.

children.title: Lot rejection criteria.
children.content: Describes the rejection criteria that will be applied against each device type.

children.title: Sample storage.
children.content: Describes how the DPA samples will be identified for retention and how and where the samples will be stored throughout the duration of the contract.

children.title: Photographs.
children.content: Describes the information that will be contained in the photographs taken of each lot sample in order to properly match the photographs to the DPA sample concerned.
